ENF Ref. No: EC15/0411--- Nature: Unauthorised use of annex as dwelling

description: Use of part of the dwelling for office purposes in connection with private vehicle hire/taxi service.
decision_conditions: Planning permission is not required as the proposed use of a room within the property for private car hire business would be incidental to the existing lawful use of the property as a single dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) and, as such, the proposal would not constitute development as defined in Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).
